    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## 0. Abstract\n",
        "\n",
        "This study asks whether historical search and engagement signals can support a more useful way to prioritize content for human review. Using the FlyRank pseudonymized warehouse and a January–June 2026 window, I aggregate historical performance into content-level features and compare a Random Forest CTR model with a transparent historical-CTR baseline. The final forward test uses May outcomes for model fitting and evaluates both approaches on June outcomes, where the Random Forest measured MAE was 0.004764 versus 0.005440 for the historical-CTR baseline, a 12.43% lower measured error. The model's strongest fitted features were historical CTR and historical average position, while the validation audit also showed that low-volume observations can produce unstable individual errors. The resulting ranked queue is therefore a decision-support tool for human review—not a causal claim, automatic publishing system, or guarantee that changing a page will improve future CTR."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "S-awbP_eRPpn"
      },
      "id": "S-awbP_eRPpn"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "IJ1RXxlmHt2E"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 1. Question\n",
        "\n",
        "**Research question:** Can historical search and engagement signals improve forward CTR prediction enough to provide a useful ranked content-review signal compared with a transparent historical-CTR baseline?\n",
        "\n",
        "**Decision:** where a human reviewer should investigate first."
      ],
      "id": "IJ1RXxlmHt2E"
    },
    {

      },
      "source": [
        "## 2. Data\n",
        "\n",
        "The full pseudonymized warehouse release is approximately 79M daily rows. Primary table: `fact_content_daily_performance`.\n",
        "\n",
        "- January–April 2026: historical feature window\n",
        "- May 2026: model-fitting/development target\n",
        "- June 2026: final forward-test target\n",
        "\n",
        "The modeling frame contains 160,595 content rows across 46 unique clients. Target-period fields, label-derived fields, product-rule fields, identifiers as predictive features, URLs, client names, titles and raw queries are excluded."
      ],
      "id": "u9dPC0TxHt2H"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 1,
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "3-Xqs2eJHt2I",
        "outputId": "b3a4bb73-9708-4543-ae34-52005ad43925"
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "DuckDB + Hugging Face authentication configured.\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "import os, json\n",
        "import duckdb\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error\n",
        "\n",
        "try:\n",
        "    from google.colab import userdata\n",
        "    HF_TOKEN = userdata.get(\"HF_TOKEN\")\n",
        "except Exception:\n",
        "    HF_TOKEN = os.environ.get(\"HF_TOKEN\")\n",
        "if not HF_TOKEN:\n",
        "    raise RuntimeError(\"HF_TOKEN not found. Add it to Colab Secrets.\")\n",
        "\n",
        "con = duckdb.connect()\n",
        "warehouse = \"hf://datasets/FlyRank/internship-warehouse\"\n",
        "PERF_GLOB = f\"{warehouse}/fact_content_daily_performance/month=*/data_0.parquet\"\n",
        "con.execute(\"DROP SECRET IF EXISTS hf_secret\")\n",
        "con.execute(\"CREATE SECRET hf_secret (TYPE huggingface, TOKEN ?)\", [HF_TOKEN])\n",
        "print(\"DuckDB + Hugging Face authentication configured.\")"
      ],
      "id": "3-Xqs2eJHt2I"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "_Q9EYsOwHt2J"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 3. Methodology\n",
        "\n",
        "Nine historical features are used: impressions, clicks, CTR, average position, pageviews, sessions, users, engaged sessions and scroll events. The baseline is historical CTR. The Random Forest uses 100 trees, max depth 12, minimum leaf size 20 and seed 42. Validation is chronological: January–April features → May target → June forward test."
      ],
      "id": "_Q9EYsOwHt2J"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 2,
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 85,
          "referenced_widgets": [
            "7d07cf37ceff42079678a05cf80da074",
            "946d35d72aab4eab955e150c9467ef78",
            "730f6077b5664f14a6f90eaca6d89f7e"
          ]
        },
        "id": "09woOWpaHt2L",
        "outputId": "3f53af80-295c-4ffc-9e5d-61d5dc2bc220"
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "FloatProgress(value=0.0, layout=Layout(width='auto'), style=ProgressStyle(bar_color='black'))"
            ],
            "application/vnd.jupyter.widget-view+json": {
              "version_major": 2,
              "version_minor": 0,
              "model_id": "7d07cf37ceff42079678a05cf80da074"
            }
          },
          "metadata": {}
        },
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Modeling rows: 160595\n",
            "Unique clients: 46\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "model_df = con.execute(f'''\n",
        "WITH base AS (\n",
        " SELECT report_date, client_hash_id, content_hash_id,\n",
        "        CAST(gsc_impressions AS DOUBLE) impressions,\n",
        "        CAST(gsc_clicks AS DOUBLE) clicks,\n",
        "        CAST(gsc_avg_position AS DOUBLE) avg_position,\n",
        "        CAST(ga4_pageviews AS DOUBLE) pageviews,\n",
        "        CAST(ga4_sessions AS DOUBLE) sessions,\n",
        "        CAST(ga4_users AS DOUBLE) users,\n",
        "        CAST(ga4_engaged_sessions AS DOUBLE) engaged_sessions,\n",
        "        CAST(scroll_events AS DOUBLE) scroll_events\n",
        " FROM read_parquet('{PERF_GLOB}', hive_partitioning=true)\n",
        " WHERE report_date >= '2026-01-01' AND report_date < '2026-07-01'\n",
        "   AND gsc_impressions IS NOT NULL AND gsc_clicks IS NOT NULL AND gsc_impressions > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "historical AS (\n",
        " SELECT client_hash_id, content_hash_id,\n",
        "        SUM(impressions) hist_impressions, SUM(clicks) hist_clicks,\n",
        "        SUM(clicks)/NULLIF(SUM(impressions),0) hist_ctr,\n",
        "        AVG(avg_position) hist_avg_position, SUM(pageviews) hist_pageviews,\n",
        "        SUM(sessions) hist_sessions, SUM(users) hist_users,\n",
        "        SUM(engaged_sessions) hist_engaged_sessions, SUM(scroll_events) hist_scroll_events\n",
        " FROM base WHERE report_date >= '2026-01-01' AND report_date < '2026-05-01'\n",
        " GROUP BY client_hash_id, content_hash_id\n",
        "),\n",
        "may_target AS (\n",
        " SELECT client_hash_id, content_hash_id,\n",
        "        SUM(clicks)/NULLIF(SUM(impressions),0) may_ctr\n",
        " FROM base WHERE report_date >= '2026-05-01' AND report_date < '2026-06-01'\n",
        " GROUP BY client_hash_id, content_hash_id\n",
        "),\n",
        "june_target AS (\n",
        " SELECT client_hash_id, content_hash_id,\n",
        "        SUM(impressions) june_impressions,\n",
        "        SUM(clicks)/NULLIF(SUM(impressions),0) june_ctr\n",
        " FROM base WHERE report_date >= '2026-06-01' AND report_date < '2026-07-01'\n",
        " GROUP BY client_hash_id, content_hash_id\n",
        ")\n",
        "SELECT h.*, m.may_ctr, j.june_impressions, j.june_ctr\n",
        "FROM historical h\n",
        "JOIN may_target m USING(client_hash_id, content_hash_id)\n",
        "JOIN june_target j USING(client_hash_id, content_hash_id)\n",
        "WHERE m.may_ctr IS NOT NULL AND j.june_ctr IS NOT NULL\n",
        "''').fetchdf()\n",
        "print(\"Modeling rows:\", len(model_df))\n",
        "print(\"Unique clients:\", model_df.client_hash_id.nunique())"
      ],
      "id": "09woOWpaHt2L"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "features = [\n",
        "    \"hist_impressions\",\"hist_clicks\",\"hist_ctr\",\"hist_avg_position\",\n",
        "    \"hist_pageviews\",\"hist_sessions\",\"hist_users\",\"hist_engaged_sessions\",\n",
        "    \"hist_scroll_events\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "X = model_df[features].replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).fillna(0)\n",
        "y_may = model_df[\"may_ctr\"].astype(float)\n",
        "y_june = model_df[\"june_ctr\"].astype(float)\n",
        "\n",
        "baseline_may = X[\"hist_ctr\"].values\n",
        "baseline_june = X[\"hist_ctr\"].values\n",
        "baseline_may_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_may, baseline_may)\n",
        "baseline_june_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_june, baseline_june)\n",
        "\n",
        "rf = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100,max_depth=12,min_samples_leaf=20,random_state=42,n_jobs=-1)\n",
        "rf.fit(X,y_may)\n",
        "rf_may = rf.predict(X)\n",
        "rf_june = rf.predict(X)\n",
        "rf_may_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_may,rf_may)\n",
        "rf_june_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_june,rf_june)\n",
        "relative = (baseline_june_mae-rf_june_mae)/baseline_june_mae*100\n",
        "\n",
        "results = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"evaluation\":[\"May development\",\"June forward test\"],\n",
        "    \"baseline_mae\":[baseline_may_mae,baseline_june_mae],\n",
        "    \"random_forest_mae\":[rf_may_mae,rf_june_mae]\n",
        "})\n",
        "display(results)\n",
        "print(f\"June relative MAE difference: {relative:.2f}% lower\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {

          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 130

      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(7,4))\n",
        "plt.bar([\"Historical CTR\",\"Random Forest\"],[baseline_june_mae,rf_june_mae])\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"June MAE\"); plt.title(\"June forward test: model vs baseline\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "feature_importance = pd.DataFrame({\"feature\":features,\"importance\":rf.feature_importances_}).sort_values(\"importance\",ascending=False)\n",
        "display(feature_importance)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))\n",
        "p=feature_importance.sort_values(\"importance\")\n",
        "plt.barh(p.feature,p.importance)\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Importance\"); plt.title(\"Descriptive Random Forest feature importance\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "overprediction_rate=(rf_june>y_june).mean()\n",
        "underprediction_rate=(rf_june<y_june).mean()\n",
        "print(f\"Overprediction rate: {overprediction_rate:.2%}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Underprediction rate: {underprediction_rate:.2%}\")"
      ],

      "source": [
        "## 5. Limitations\n",
        "\n",
        "Only one final forward period is evaluated. Prediction error is not causal evidence. Search intent, SERP features, editorial quality, business value and algorithm changes are not directly observed. Low-volume observations can have unstable CTR. Generalization to other periods or populations is unproven."
      ],
      "id": "J0rxB0eAHt2O"

      "source": [
        "reason_summary = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        " \"reason_code\":[\"POSITION_OPPORTUNITY\",\"STABLE_LOW_PRIORITY\",\"HIGH_OPPORTUNITY\",\"CTR_GAP\",\"LOW_VOLUME_CAUTION\"],\n",

        "display(reason_summary)\n",

        "plt.bar(reason_summary.reason_code,reason_summary[\"count\"])\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=25,ha=\"right\"); plt.ylabel(\"Records\"); plt.title(\"Action playbook reason-code mix\")\n",

        "## ML-12 closing cells\n",
        "\n",
        "### 5-minute demo outline\n",
        "1. State the research question and decision.\n",
        "2. Show chronological validation.\n",
        "3. Compare June MAE with the baseline.\n",
        "4. Show feature importance and the low-volume limitation.\n",
        "5. Walk through the action-playbook workflow.\n",
        "6. End with the honest decision-support claim.\n",
        "\n",
        "### Social-post cut\n",
        "Built a time-aware content-opportunity model on the FlyRank ML Internship dataset. In a June 2026 forward test, Random Forest MAE was 12.43% lower than a historical-CTR baseline. The result is decision support with human review and low-volume caution—not automatic content changes.\n",
        "\n",
        "### Employer-facing summary\n",
        "I built an end-to-end search-intelligence ML workflow covering feature engineering, Random Forest regression, temporal validation, leakage auditing and ranked recommendations. On the June forward test, the model measured 0.004764 MAE versus 0.005440 for the historical-CTR baseline, a 12.43% lower error. I packaged the result as a public-safe research artifact with reproducible notebooks, honest limitations and a human-review action playbook."
